rootCauseOneLine: The thread.new command handler in apps/app/src/components/layout/AppLayout.tsx only navigates to "/"; the composer's project comes from the global localStorage atom bb.root-compose.project-id, which PR #458 deliberately made "sticky to last prompt" and stopped syncing to the open thread, so Cmd+N/Ctrl+Shift+O opens the composer in the last-used project instead of the active thread's project.

prReviews.topFinding: Fixes only the thread.new shortcut/menu path and leaves the sidebar 'New thread' button (which advertises the same shortcut) on the old sticky policy: after the PR, clicking the button from an Alpha thread opens the composer on Beta while pressing Ctrl+Shift+O opens it on Alpha (verified live). It also silently reverses PR #458's deliberate 'sticky to last prompt' decision without flagging it, and the rewritten test drops the #458 guard that opening a thread alone must not change the preference.

proposedFix: Maintainer first decides the policy (sticky-to-last-prompt per #458 vs active-project per the command's own description "Start a thread in the active project"). If active-project: add one shared hook (e.g. useOpenNewThreadComposer) that reads useRouteState().projectId, calls setRootComposeProjectId(projectId) when defined, then navigates to getRootComposeRoutePath() with focusPrompt; use it from BOTH the thread.new handler in AppLayout.tsx and handleNewChat in AppSidebar.tsx; decide/test the projectless-thread case (proj_personal => "no project"); keep the #458 assertion in AppLayout.root-compose-project.test.tsx alongside the new command test. UI-only, no protocol bump.
caveats: Issue and PR are both agent-filed by the same author with no user report; the "bug" is a product-policy disagreement with PR #458 rather than a defect. Cmd+N itself is desktop-only; the web repro used the equivalent Ctrl+Shift+O binding of the same thread.new command. PR was tested by cherry-picking a43d39524 onto base 16ceb3a54 (applies cleanly; PR branch is 43 commits behind main). End-to-end thread creation in the wrong project was not exercised (would spend a provider turn); it follows directly from RootComposeView passing the stored project to the composer. Worktree left at 16ceb3a54 with no changes; dev instance stopped.
